description: A Python script implementing a command class 'RebaselineCL' for fetching new baselines from try jobs for a code review CL, including methods for managing try builds, fetching results, and determining tests to rebaseline.

classes.name: RebaselineCL
classes.description: A command class for rebaselining tests based on try job results, managing build triggers, fetching results, and determining tests to rebaseline.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RebaselineCL command with specific options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that manages the rebaseline process, including checking unstaged baselines, fetching try job results, and triggering rebaselines.

methods.name: _get_issue_number
methods.description: Retrieves the current CL issue number, or None if invalid.

methods.name: git_cl
methods.description: Returns a GitCL instance; can be overridden for testing.

methods.name: trigger_builds
methods.description: Triggers try jobs for specified builders.

methods.name: builders_with_no_results
methods.description: Returns builders that have no finished results.

methods.name: _try_bots
methods.description: Returns a collection of try bot builder names.

methods.name: _fetch_results
methods.description: Fetches test results for a list of builds.

methods.name: _test_prefix_list
methods.description: Determines which tests need to be rebaselined based on results and changed files.

methods.name: _tests_to_rebaseline
methods.description: Identifies tests to rebaseline for a specific build.

methods.name: _fetch_tests_with_new_failures
methods.description: Lists tests with new failures from a try job.

methods.name: _log_test_prefix_list
methods.description: Logs the list of tests to rebaseline.

methods.name: rebaseline
methods.description: Initiates the rebaselining process for specified tests.
